name: Lucy
bio: Archetype: Dynamo, Extra Action, Skill Enhancement, Snowball. ⌽ Gain [Dynamo] when self and allies gain Moxie or [Eureka] or when an enemy is defeated. ⌽ Skills consume [Dynamo] to gain additional effects. ⌽ Consumes [Dynamo] at turn start to reinforce one of Lucy's skills. ⌽ Ultimate grants her Afflatus advantage against all enemies and increases the Afflatus advantage multiplier for the whole team. ⌽ Unleashes an FUA after casting Ult or whenever an enemy is defeated. ⌽ Gain [Data Iteration], granting a stacking ATK Buff after casting Ult or whenever an enemy is defeated.
